newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico 1996 department store sales fall 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico 1996 department store sales fall 10 pct.

text.p: Mexico's department store sales fell 10 percent in 1996 compared to the year before, the National Association of Self-Service and Department Stores (ANTAD) said on Monday.
ANTAD also said that self-service store sales fell nine percent in 1996 compared to the year before.
In a news conference, the ANTAD president, Antonio Chedraui said that in self-service stores the largest drop was seen in clothing sales, and in department stores it was in durable goods.
He said that they do not expect sales to continue falling in 1997, but that the recovery will likely not be seen until 1998.
He added that 250 new department and self-service stores are expected to open in Mexico this year.
